controls.FRICTION/a11y.readMeOverview: Friction is an interactive sim. It changes as you play with it. Get ready for Friction, there’s a stack of big textbooks ready to go. In zoomed-in view of textbooks you can observe how jiggling atoms and temperature change.
controls.FRICTION/a11y.breakAwaySentenceFirst: {{temp}}. Atoms break away from chemistry book.
controls.FRICTION/a11y.screenSummary.jiggleTemper: In zoomed-in view of where books meet, {{temperatureClause}}, {{jigglingClause}}.
controls.FRICTION/a11y.screenSummary.startingChem: {{relativeChemistryBookSentence}}Chemistry book rests on top of a Physics book, and is ready to be rubbed against it.
{{relativeChemistryBookSentence}}Chemistry book rests lightly on top of a Physics book, and is ready to be rubbed against it.
controls.FRICTION/a11y.amountOfAtoms.sentence: Chemistry book has {{comparisonAmount}} jiggling atoms as {{breakAwayAmount}} have broken away.{{space}}
controls.FRICTION/a11y.screenSummary.continueRubb: Grab Chemistry book to rub fast or slow.
controls.FRICTION/a11y.initialTouchGrabbedNotTouc: Grabbed. Lightly on Physics book. Drag finger to move book. Lift finger to release.
controls.FRICTION/a11y.initialKeyboardGrabbedNotT: Grabbed. Lightly on Physics book. Move book with W, A, S, or D key. Space to release.
controls.FRICTION/a11y.initialTouchGrabbedTouchin: Grabbed. Rub fast or slow dragging left or right. Lift to release.
controls.FRICTION/a11y.initialKeyboardGrabbedTouc: Grabbed. Rub fast or slow with A or D keys. Space to release.
controls.FRICTION/a11y.grabButtonHelpText: Look for grab buttons. Once grabbed, use keyboard shortcuts to move book or zoomed-in book.
